proposals.title: stockholder proposal to rescind the 2021 "reduce scope 3 emissions" stockholder proposal
proposals.topic_summary: Asks shareholders to rescind the 2021 non-binding resolution to substantially reduce Scope 3 emissions, arguing it harms financial returns and cannot affect global climate.
proposals.evidence: Therefore, your board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: stockholder proposal to set a medium-term Scope 3 GHG emissions reduction target
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a medium-term Scope 3 GHG emissions reduction target aligned with the Paris Climate Agreement, with strategy left to the board.
proposals.evidence: Therefore, your board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: stockholder proposal to recalculate emissions baseline to exclude emissions from material divestitures
proposals.proponent: Curtis Overway, represented by Danielle Fugere at As You Sow
proposals.topic_summary: Requests disclosure of a recalculated emissions baseline excluding aggregated GHG emissions from material asset divestitures since 2016, plus a recalculation policy.
proposals.evidence: Therefore, your board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: stockholder proposal to establish board committee on decarbonization risk
proposals.proponent: David Bahnsen, Trustee of The Bahnsen Family Trust Dated July 15, 2003
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a new Board Committee on Decarbonization Risk to review strategy and responses to decarbonization demands and related climate model and feasibility risks.
proposals.evidence: Therefore, your board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: stockholder proposal to report on worker and community impact from facility closures and energy transitions
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on the social impact on workers and communities from facility closures or energy transitions, and mitigation alternatives, by 2024 Annual Meeting.
proposals.evidence: Therefore, your board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: stockholder proposal to report on racial equity audit
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an independent racial equity audit of policies and practices that disparately impact communities of color, with findings publicly disclosed and steps recommended.
proposals.evidence: Therefore, your board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: stockholder proposal to report on tax practices
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a tax transparency report prepared under the GRI Tax Standard (GRI 207), including country-level disclosure of revenues, profits and tax payments.
proposals.evidence: Therefore, your board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: stockholder proposal regarding independent chair
proposals.proponent: Newground Social Investment on behalf of Diane Turner
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a bylaw policy requiring the Board Chair to be an independent director whenever possible, starting with the next CEO transition.
proposals.evidence: Therefore, your board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.
